The Millennium. A time for new ideas, better games... a fresh start. So what better way to learn all about it than to join Stumpy as he delves into everything from the launch of the PlayStation 2 to the birth of esports as we know it?

While those naughty folks at EA were figuring out how to best monetise their games, Nintendo were busy releasing not only one of the best consoles of all time, but some of the best games too. As always, Stumpy's on hand to be your trusty guide as he takes you through 2017 in this episode of The Archive.

E-sports programme brought to you by GINX - the largest esports network and the home of esports on TV! Shut Up & Play! is all about the gameplay. Each episode you can watch NPCs taking on the biggest and best games around. With games ranging from strategy, racing and platformers to horror-adventure games.

It's a double bill for our Halloween episode of The First Hour, but the guys cannot decide what to wear. So they decide to dig out the old costumes from episodes past, with predictably chaotic results. Ant and Sav then jump into The Casting of Frank Stone and Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2.

The mid-90s was an interesting time in the gaming world. Sony had already shifted the balance of power with the release of the Playstation, and a whole host of consoles were on their last legs. But 1996 was the year that Nintendo made a stand; to unleash a double-headed beast. It was time for the N64. It was the time for Pokemon!

Skyrim, Dark Souls, Minecraft... 2011 was responsible for some huge titles, but it will also forever be associated with the Sony hack. In today's Archive, Stumpy's back again to walk you through a very tumultuous year.
